mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS report_id, r.kind AS kind, r.type AS type, r.urgent AS urgent, r.status AS status, r.reporter_id AS reporter_id, rm.nickname AS reporter_nickname, r.target_member_id AS target_id, tm.nickname AS target_nickname, r.basecamp_id AS basecamp_id, r.created_at AS created_at, r.content AS content, r.result_note AS result_note, r.handled_by AS handled_by, r.handled_at AS handled_at, b.title AS basecamp_title, b.status AS basecamp_status, b.start_date AS basecamp_start_date, cr.id AS review_id, cr.comment AS review_comment, cr.rejoin_wanted AS review_rejoin_wanted, (cr.hidden_at IS NOT NULL) AS review_hidden FROM member_report r JOIN member rm ON rm.id = r.reporter_id JOIN member tm ON tm.id = r.target_member_id JOIN basecamp b ON b.id = r.basecamp_id LEFT JOIN companion_review cr ON cr.id = r.companion_review_id WHERE r.id = #{reportId}
SELECT t.tag FROM companion_review_tag t WHERE t.review_id = #{reviewId} ORDER BY t.tag ASC

SELECT s.id AS sanction_id, s.type AS type, s.level AS level, s.status AS status, s.reason AS reason, s.starts_at AS starts_at, s.ends_at AS ends_at, s.lifted_at AS lifted_at FROM sanction s LEFT JOIN member_report mr ON mr.id = s.report_id WHERE s.member_id = #{memberId} AND NOT (s.type = 'TEMPORARY_72H' AND mr.status = 'DISMISSED') ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC
